scoring_justification: Properties are computed by a DFT workflow that the verifier cannot re-execute; we compare the agent's reported values to the paper's PW91/SDD results with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values for TM@Li14 properties (PW91/SDD) and W@Li14 isomer relative energies from the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 2 (PW91 row) and Table 1 (W row).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the published manuscript.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact reported numbers in the source paper, used to validate a correct reproduction.

required.Sc: magnetic_moment, HOMO_LUMO_gap, Eb, Ef, De, symmetry
required.Ti: magnetic_moment, HOMO_LUMO_gap, Eb, Ef, De, symmetry
required.V: magnetic_moment, HOMO_LUMO_gap, Eb, Ef, De, symmetry
required.W: magnetic_moment, HOMO_LUMO_gap, Eb, Ef, De, symmetry, isomer_energies

outputs.description: Computed magnetic moments, HOMO-LUMO gaps, stability energies, and relative isomer energies for TM = Sc, Ti, V, W. Checked against paper-reported values with tolerances.
Optimized Cartesian coordinates of the D6d cage structures for all nine TM@Li14 clusters. Structural audit checks for presence of each TM, D6d label, 15 atoms per frame, and plausible total energies.

output_contract.notes: All scored quantities are computed by the agent from DFT and structure search results. The checker will compare reported values to hidden paper references using appropriate tolerances (result-level compare) and perform a structural audit on the XYZ file. No hidden gold values or tolerances are disclosed here.
